statements.status_notes: This vulnerability is mitigated by the kernel-level fix for CVE-2012-6638. While the vulnerable code exists in libxt_tcp.c, the kernel prevents exploitation of the SYN+FIN packet matching issue. Debian has marked this "unimportant" due to the kernel mitigation making this userspace issue non-exploitable.
